info.name: CityCare API
info.description:
All endpoints of the CityCare backend (city complaint and service request platform).

Start with the folder "Demo flow". Its first three requests login as admin, staff and citizen and save the tokens. The other requests use the saved tokens and ids automatically.

Change the collection variable baseUrl to test another server.

item.name: Demo flow (run from top to bottom)
item.description: The full journey with the seeded demo accounts. Every request saves what the next one needs.

item.name: List complaints with search, filters, sorting and pagination

request.description: Access: Any logged in user. A citizen sees own complaints, a staff member sees assigned complaints, an admin sees everything.

item.name: Track a complaint with its tracking code

request.description: Access: Public. Shows the status and the timeline. No personal data. A report its citizen made public also shows its id, a rounded location and the number of supporters.

item.name: Get complaint details with the timeline

request.description: Access: Citizen or Admin. The citizen can edit before it is assigned. An admin can only change the priority.

item.name: Assign a complaint to a staff member

request.description: Access: Admin. Leave staffId out to let the system pick the staff member with the fewest active complaints. A staff member has a capacity limit.

item.name: Change the status of a complaint

request.description: Access: Staff or Admin. Staff: ASSIGNED to IN_PROGRESS to RESOLVED. Admin: REJECTED or CLOSED. Rejecting a paid request refunds the fee.

item.name: Cancel own complaint before it is assigned
Transfer a complaint to another department
Give feedback on a resolved complaint

request.description: Access: Citizen. Feedback closes the complaint.
Access: Any logged in user. Send form-data with the field "images". JPG, PNG or WEBP, 2 MB each, 2 files per request, 6 per complaint.

formdata.description: Choose 1 or 2 JPG, PNG or WEBP images

item.name: Remove an image from a complaint
Get complaints that have a location, for a map

request.description: Access: Any logged in user. An admin sees every complaint, a staff member the assigned jobs and a citizen their own reports. Open ones by default.

item.name: Get the messages on a complaint

request.description: Access: Any logged in user. Whoever can open the complaint can read its messages. Citizens do not see the internal notes of the city team.

item.name: Send a message or an internal note on a complaint

request.description: Access: Any logged in user. Staff and admins can set internal to true for a note the citizen does not see. The other people on the complaint get a notification.
Access: Any logged in user. The author can remove a message within 15 minutes. An admin can remove any message.

item.name: List public reports for the city map

request.description: Access: Public. Open or recently resolved complaints that their citizen made public and that have a location. No personal data, coordinates rounded to about 10 meters. Cached for one minute.

item.name: Find open public reports near a spot

request.description: Access: Any logged in user. The report wizard uses it to show possible duplicates before a new report is sent. Up to 5 reports, closest first.

item.name: Support a public report that affects you too

request.description: Access: Citizen. Sending it twice changes nothing. The owner is told at 1, 5, 10, 25, 50 and 100 supporters.

item.name: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a service request

request.description: Access: Citizen. Open checkoutUrl in a browser to pay. A frontend can send clientUrl to get the user back on its own pages.

exec: console.log('Open this link in a browser to pay:', body.data.checkoutUrl);

item.name: Stripe sends the user here after a successful payment

request.description: Access: Public. The server checks the session with Stripe before it completes the payment.

item.name: Stripe sends the user here when the checkout is cancelled
Verify a checkout session with Stripe

request.description: Access: Stripe. Called by Stripe only. The signature is verified with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

item.name: Refund a payment of a rejected or cancelled request

request.description: Access: Admin. Refunds are automatic. This endpoint is for a retry when an automatic refund failed.
Access: Any logged in user. Created when a complaint is assigned, changes status, gets a comment, a rating or a payment, or misses its deadline.
